title: leucanthemum catananche
intro: Leucanthemum catananche, commonly known as Oat Flower or Button Leek, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion due to its properties as a demulcent and anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum catananche include its use in traditional medicine as a treatment for digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory issues, with its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds. However, further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Leucanthemum catananche on human health.
